description: Azure DevOps pull request and commit activity per repository, with author breakdown. Requires an Infinity datasource using Basic Auth with a PAT (user or service account, Code Read scope).

links.title: FYI: This dashboard only returns the top 101 results per repo

options.content:
# Devops Pull Requests and Commits

Select a Project and one or more Repositories to see the report of Pull Requests and Commits. 

For each repo selected, the below rows will be repeated.

list.description: The organization segment of your dev.azure.com URL, e.g. "foo" in https://dev.azure.com/foo
list.label: Azure DevOps organization
list.name: AZDO_ORG
